activation.fleet: simulated support fleet, outcomes drawn by this script

hub.what: per-request floor (auth + rate limit) under concurrency, not search latency

cold_start.what: fresh venv: pip install . -> init -> proof wizard --yes -> gateway -> first POST /v1/recall returning a holdout assignment
cold_start.note: this machine, warm pip cache for dependencies; a customer on a slow link adds download time

signal_clustering.what: adjusted Rand index of failure signals vs labelled failure modes (commons/eval/signal_ari.py)

after.method: stemmed IDF-weighted cosine, average linkage, threshold 0.15 (chosen on seeds 100-104)

signal_clustering.caveat: synthetic wording; the threshold is sensitive (0.2 gives 0.79); run `commontrace signals list` on real traces

outcome_detection.what: precision of SUCCESS calls on 60 hand-labelled cases (commons/eval/outcome_labelled.jsonl)
outcome_detection.caveat: written by the detectors' author: a regression suite for the stated rules, not evidence about a real fleet. Needs a design partner's labelled sample.

draft_quality.what: share of model drafts that pass the approval gates as written (commons/eval/draft_quality.py)
draft_quality.note: needs COMMONTRACE_LLM_* and a price table; --drafter stub validates the harness only
